title: A Unified Framework and Dataset for Assessing Societal Bias in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting vision-language models with bias-bleached text and images (e.g., humanoid robots performing professional actions) and measuring the preference for male versus female identities using direct questions and indirect actor-replacement probes.

Prompting vision-language models with bias-bleached multimodal inputs of professional actions and measuring the distribution of predicted racial identities (Caucasian, Asian, African American) using direct and indirect probing methods.
Prompting vision-language models with bias-bleached multimodal inputs of professional actions and measuring the distribution of predicted age groups using direct and indirect probing methods.
